database_admission_chain.interaction_rule: Each gate produces its own evidence. PASS only permits evaluation of the next gate; it never grants the next gate PASS. FAIL or UNKNOWN stops reachability. Later gates become UNREACHED, not PASS.

segments.name: VALID_RESEARCH
segments.exit: date-aligned research dataset admitted with temporal evidence and no-lookahead proof

segments.name: VALID_BACKTEST
segments.exit: ordered backtest evidence with OOS isolation, integrity checks, and reproducible receipt

segments.name: EDGE
segments.exit: edge claim supported by admissible research/backtest evidence only

segments.name: EV_PNL_ROI
segments.exit: finite non-NaN/non-Inf EV/P&L/ROI evidence with explicit assumptions

segments.name: ROBUSTNESS_RISK_DRIFT
segments.exit: robustness, risk, drift and sensitivity evidence sufficient for governance review

segments.name: CONTROLLED_ACTION
segments.exit: governance gate has its own fresh evidence and explicit authorization

core_mission_e2e.dependency_rule: Each segment is blocked until its own exit evidence exists; downstream work may be developed as safe preparation but cannot inherit upstream PASS.
core_mission_e2e.selection_rule: Every next action must name the current E2E segment, immediate blocker, evidence required to exit the segment, downstream consequence, and safe parallel work that can proceed without bypassing any gate.

quant_n010_observation: A push to Quant_Engine commit 974261037644f106d6be6681c699737f6c842e25 was used to trigger its existing admission workflow; the GitHub workflow-run observation surface returned zero observable runs, therefore workflow PASS remains UNKNOWN and is not self-attested.
completion_gate: Fresh independently observable exact-current evidence is required before CI_TESTED, RUNTIME_VERIFIED, or PROMOTION can change from UNKNOWN/DENY

next_action_format.rule: Immediate next action is a step inside the E2E plan, never an orphan task. A next action is complete only when its stated evidence and exit criteria are satisfied.
